## Motivation & Clinical Context

Electrocardiogram (ECG) reconstruction aims to estimate a complete **12-lead ECG representation** from a reduced subset of leads—such as a single wearable-like Lead I or a 3-lead input. Mean Squared Error (MSE) is a standard objective, but conditional averaging can attenuate morphology when the missing signal is not uniquely determined by the observed leads. This handbook tests that concern rather than assuming it.

### The Regression-to-the-Mean Failure (Presacan et al., 2025)

In *Communications Medicine* (Nature Portfolio), **Presacan et al. (2025)** reported regression-to-the-mean behavior in ECG reconstruction trained with MSE. More generally, squared-error population risk targets a conditional expectation; when multiple missing-lead morphologies are compatible with the observed leads, averaging can attenuate uncommon amplitudes or shapes. Whether that occurs for a particular checkpoint and endpoint is measured here rather than assumed from the theorem or prior paper.

Potential failure modes include P/T delineation error, ST-segment attenuation, and QT/QTc drift. These are hypotheses requiring artifact-backed evaluation; the book does not infer patient harm from synthetic waveforms or global similarity metrics.

```
       MSE Loss (Regression to Mean)          Combinatorial Composite Loss (Ours)
    ┌─────────────────────────────────┐      ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
    │  Flat P-waves / Flattened ST    │      │  Candidate shape preservation  │
    │  Damped Peak Amplitudes         │  vs  │  QTc/VCG metrics require audit │
    │  Metrics requiring audit        │      │  No assumed clinical benefit   │
    └─────────────────────────────────┘      └─────────────────────────────────┘
```

## How to read this handbook

For current experiment status, start with the [Live Experiment Observatory](15_live_results_observatory.qmd),
then open either the [three-lead queue and source monitor](16_three_lead_ecgaim_live.qmd)
or the [one-lead active/pending monitor](17_one_lead_wavelet_ssl_live.qmd).
Completed one-lead screening, spatial, convergence, and external RDB results now
have separate chapters, as do completed three-lead LUDB/RDB morphology,
representation, and LUDB semi-supervised delineation studies.
For a visual cross-experiment view, use the
[Deep ECG-AIM Evidence Dashboard](31_deep_evidence_visual_dashboard.qmd), which
shows matched mechanism effects, learning trajectories, external transport,
boundary-specific failures, and paired linear-probe intervals without merging
incompatible endpoints.

The book begins with evidence, not demonstrations. The [opening real-data EDA](09_real_data_eda_and_diagnostics.qmd) audits PTB-XL and EchoNext in depth and now provides separate, stability-audited waveform UMAPs for every locally supported clinical cohort: PTB-XL, EchoNext, LUDB, ISP, Sunnybrook, Zhejiang, and RDB. The [multi-dataset atlas](11_dataset_atlas_ludb_isp_sunnybrook.qmd) establishes what the smaller morphology cohorts contribute, followed by a separate [Zhejiang file-level audit](05_zhejiang_delineation_tutorial.qmd). Only after those measurement contracts are visible does the [PTB-XL preprocessing contract](01_dataset_and_preprocessing.qmd) explain the content-pinned tensors and lead mapping.

The remaining parts follow the causal order of the study:

1.  **Data, cohorts, and measurement** — what was observed, how records were partitioned, and which claims each dataset can support.
2.  **Reconstruction models and objectives** — the architectures and loss terms applied to those inputs.
3.  **Clinical and statistical evaluation** — paired morphology, delineation, agreement, fairness, robustness, and uncertainty.
4.  **Benchmark and external validation** — the locked 48-cell evidence,
    coverage-limited seven-mask generations, completed external morphology,
    device transfer, and EchoNext classifier preservation.

This order is deliberate. A model ranking is uninterpretable until the reader knows the units, split boundary, repeated-patient structure, endpoint prevalence, and downstream measurement contract. Synthetic examples remain in the book as executable tutorials, but they are labeled as demonstrations and never substitute for cohort evidence.

## Evidence status at a glance

| Evidence stream | Current status | Interpretation |
|------------------------|------------------------|------------------------|
| Local dataset inventories and EDA | Executed from `data/` | Describes the actual repository cohorts and files |
| Generation-bound 48-cell reconstruction benchmark | Computation complete; final package gate 9/10 | Supports generation-bound descriptive and prespecified paired analyses; independent fresh review remains unavailable |
| EchoNext frozen-classifier outputs | Reviewed figures and label audit retained; record-level recomputation inputs absent on compact disk | Supports integrity-checked evidence display, not an independent rerun of probability/calibration analyses |
| Three-lead seven-position checkpoints | U-Net 160/160; MSVAE 155/160; ECG-AIM 123/160 registered at the audited snapshot | Cross-architecture inference remains blocked by missing cells and current-contract incompatibility for archived MSVAE/ECG-AIM generations |
| One-lead `1110000` screen | Terminal: 115/120 completed, five named failures | Completed short-budget screening evidence; not a live queue or replicated confirmation |
| One-lead convergence | 33 terminal run artifacts: 23 ten-epoch and 10 fifteen-epoch; queue ledger remains stale | Artifact-backed generations are complete; queue labels are retained only for reconciliation |
| One-lead external RDB | Full-stage evaluation complete for 60 spatial checkpoints plus two sentinels | Reports waveform, six-boundary, and region endpoints; not prospective validation |
| Three-lead external morphology | LUDB blinded 124/124; RDB blinded 32/32; RDB oracle 31/31 | Completed generation-specific external evidence with unequal selection denominators |
| ECG-AIM representation study | 11/11 checkpoint jobs complete | Quantitative probes and stability analyses; UMAP appearance alone is descriptive |

The distinction between **observed**, **derived**, **planned**, and **synthetic** evidence is maintained throughout the book.
